item.text: The first comparison confirms the orientation. I’ll adjust the back lean and plate proportions, then add the small rectangular opening near the bend. You can follow the model in the [CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8770/#part.FCStd).

arguments.code:
w=60
L=65
H=80
lean=25
t=3
pts=[(-L,0),(0,0),(lean,H),(lean-t,H),(-t,t),(-L,t)]
body=cq.Workplane('YZ').polyline(pts).close().extrude(w)
base_hole=cq.Workplane('XY').box(10,6,12).translate((30,-8,2))
back_hole=cq.Workplane('XY').box(10,30,12).translate((30,3,15))
result=body.cut(base_hole).cut(back_hole)

result=body.cut(base_hole).cut(back_hole)
